jira.name: Jira Integration
jira.description: Create Jira Epics, Stories, and Issues from spec-kit specifications and task breakdowns with configurable hierarchy and custom field support. Uses the Atlassian MCP server.
jira.author: mbachorik

vetting.notes: Prompt-only extension: 3 Markdown commands (specstoissues, discover-fields, sync-status), 1 optional after_tasks hook. No scripts or binaries. All Jira access via the configured Atlassian MCP server; writes only when a command is run.

issue-flow.name: Issue Flow
issue-flow.description: GitHub issue-driven spec-driven development flow with approvals, stacked PRs and test gating. Pairs with the issue-to-pr and issue-flow-stage workflows.
issue-flow.author: integrationfirst

vetting.notes: First-party extension (integrationfirst). 4 Markdown commands plus a Python CLI (bin/issue-flow.sh) that calls gh and git. Writes to GitHub (issues, comments, branches, PRs) and optionally Confluence via the agent. Approvals only count from logins in the config committed on the default branch. Headless permissions exclude gh and git push and deny edits to the extension directory. Zip excludes tests/. 0.1.1: CLI-only state writes (set-page), agents limited to request/set-page/pull-issue, approvers read from origin's default branch (fetched), standalone stage dry runs, always stacked.
